The '''Veila farm''' was a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was owned by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] [[Tryst Veila]] and his wife [[Cassa Veila|Cassa]]. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], an injured [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] named [[Sliven]] crawled to their doorstep after surviving a battle against [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and traveling through the desert for [[Standard day/Legends|days]] without [[Water/Legends|water]]. Cassa took Sliven in and together with Tryst, they nursed him back to health in a span of [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. As soon as he regained his strength, Sliven repaid their kindness by helping out with household chores, fashioning a [[Gaderffii/Legends|Gaderffii]] for Tryst and teaching him how to use it.<ref name="Promises" />
